comment: one of the best classes I have ever taken, genuinely learned so much that I will take with me past this class. the discussions are always very engaging. definitely take dr. oware, he's one of the best professors in the dept!!
I learned so much and was excited for class every day 10/10 recommend
very prestigious. Would take his class again.

Avoid. Material is not challenging but tests are completely short answer and grading is so subjective. 0 clear guidelines. It ended up fine but the way this class was organized was extremely stress inducing for me. He also would make rude comments at times that were very unnecessary.

OWare is a great professor. He's very knowledgeable about the topics and is passionate as well.
However, he does not post lecture slideshows for exams because he believes that students would not show up if he did. This made it exceedingly difficult to study for exams. If you did not write something from the slides, you were doomed if tested on it.

Dr. Oware was a nice professor. I had a hard time in class but he was very fast with his grading and gave clear feedback. I had a solid A all semester and it dropped to an A- after the final (and I didn't get an explanation for that) even though I thought that I did well, but overall he was pretty clear and a solid choice for a Sociology professor.

Dr. Oware is a really fun and welcoming professor. He always chooses topics that are engaging for class discussion. His descriptions for main ideas aren't always clear, but if you meet with him during office hours he is super helpful. Definitely take him if you are looking for a discussion-based class with a moderate workload
